paragraphs: R' Shimon son of the deputy, meaning the son of R' Hananyah, deputy of the priests; see his entry. He saw the Temple and its destruction. In Ketubbot, chapter 2, mishnah 8, 23 end of side b, Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel reports in R' Shimon son of the deputy's name. At the end of Shekalim, 8:5; Bava Batra 31, end of side b; and the end of Menahot, chapter 11, 100b, mishnah 9, Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel reports in his name. Pesahim, chapter 3, 47a. Rambam writes that he is mentioned only in Ketubbot, chapter 2.
